findings: MaRDI full-work URL is the already known DOI, not a repository copy.

The web-indexed original issue page actually advertises XML/download links for the target article. Its XML link resolves to /doi/xml/10.2307/2373533, then redirects to the same empty article landing in the web tool; no original text obtained.
The ordinary issue request returned HTTP200 but3038-byte Client Challenge HTML, not the indexed contents; no challenge script requested or run.
The numeric OCLC query also returns unrelated identifiers, which were rejected; no mathematical inference.
